name: Vector Sport TLR

origin.basis: Goodyear's bicycle-tire line was developed with Rubber Kinetics by a team at Goodyear's Akron, Ohio headquarters (Bicycle Retailer, 2018).

manufacturing.basis: Goodyear does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Protected 60 TPI training tire with Dual R:Shield, in its tubeless-ready construction.
weight_basis: Goodyear store weights for this construction.

availability.note: Sold by Goodyear Bicycle Tires' US-dollar web store; mainland China and European availability not verified for this model.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; US shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: The store does not show which construction a colour option ships in; confirm tubeless-ready before ordering.

image.shown: Goodyear's cutaway render of the tubeless-ready Vector Sport; one render covers every width.
image.alt: Goodyear Vector Sport tubeless-ready road tire render with a cutaway showing the casing

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.
